name: varg-tryon-video
description: Turns a flat-lay or product photo of clothing into a try-on video on varg: clean the garment photo, dress a model photo in it with Bria Virtual Try-On (or a Nano Banana / GPT Image edit for harder garments), keep the same model across shots, then animate fit-check motions that sell clothes (slow turn, tug and let fall, walk to camera, mirror selfie, fabric close-up) on Kling 4 or Seedance 2.5 with the garment kept intact, and add size captions so the fit is honest. Use when a fashion or apparel seller (Shopify, TikTok Shop, Amazon, dropshipping) asks for a try-on video, "my clothes on a model", an AI model wearing their product, a fit-check or outfit video, a try-on haul, or virtual try-on from flat-lays. Not for accessories that need no body (use product-photo-to-video) or for consistent characters across a story (varg-character-design).
